page_data_script:
products = frappe.get_all(
    "Item", 
    filters={"custom_publish_to_website": 1}, 
    fields=["name", "item_name", "item_code", "image", "standard_rate", "custom_route", "item_group"], 
    ignore_permissions=True,
)

default_currency = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_currency")


for product in products:
    product["standard_rate"] = frappe.utils.fmt_money(product["standard_rate"], currency=default_currency)
    
categories = frappe.get_all(
    "Item Group",
    filters={"custom_publish_to_website": 1, "is_group": 1, "name": ["!=", "All Item Groups"]},
    fields=["name", "item_group_name", "image", "custom_route"],
    ignore_permissions=True
)


brands = frappe.get_all(
    "Brand",
    filters={"custom_publish_to_website": 1}, 
    fields=["name", "image", "brand", "description"], 
    ignore_permissions=True
)

banner_slider_doc = frappe.get_all(
    "Website Slideshow", 
    filters={"custom_show_in": "Home Banner"},
    fields=['name'],
    ignore_permissions=True
)

banner_sliders = frappe.get_all(
    "Website Slideshow Item",
    fields=["heading", "description", "image", "url"], 
    filters={
        "parent": banner_slider_doc[0]
    },
    order_by="idx",
    ignore_permissions=True
)


data.products = products
data.grab_deal_products = products[:10]
data.categories = categories
data.banner_sliders = banner_sliders
data.brands = brands

data.page_data = {
    "products": products
}

page_data_script:
all_categories = frappe.call('hopkins.api.item_group.get_categories')
category_route = frappe.form_dict.get('category_route')
category = frappe.call('hopkins.api.item_group.search_category', categories=all_categories, category_route=category_route) 
page = frappe.form_dict.get('page', 1) 
limit = frappe.form_dict.get('limit', 12) 
products_data = frappe.call('hopkins.api.item_group.get_products', category_name=category.get("name"), page=page, limit=limit)

total_products  = products_data["total_products"]
start_product = (products_data["page"] - 1) * products_data["limit"] + 1
end_product = min(products_data["page"] * products_data["limit"], products_data["total_products"])
pagination_text = f"Showing {start_product}-{end_product} of {total_products} Products"
 
data.all_categories = all_categories
data.category = category
data.products_data = products_data
data.pagination_text =pagination_text
